summary: Attendance tracking module testing completed. Fixed critical infinite loop bug in useEffect. All core features working: page navigation, activity selection, member list loading, attendance marking (Present/Absent), All Present button, Save attendance, QR tab, Reports tab.
passed_tests: ✅ 3 tabs visible: تسجيل الحضور, تسجيل سريع QR, التقارير
✅ Activity dropdown (data-testid='activity-select') shows Arabic names correctly
✅ Member list appears with names, phone numbers, and attendance buttons
✅ 'الكل حاضر' (All Present) button marks all members as present
✅ Success toast 'تم حفظ حضور X عضو' shown after save
✅ QR tab shows quick check-in form and QR code generator
✅ Reports tab shows date filters and report generation options

bugs_fixed.issue: Activity dropdown showing empty text for Arabic activity names
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed `a.name` to `a.name_ar || a.name` in all 3 activity dropdowns

bugs_fixed.issue: CRITICAL: Infinite loop causing hundreds of API requests per second
bugs_fixed.root_cause: useEffect with fetchAttendance in dependency array was re-triggering because useCallback had `t` (translation function) in its dependencies, which changes on every render
bugs_fixed.fix: Removed the auto-fetch useEffect and removed `t` from useCallback dependencies. Now attendance only fetches when Load button is clicked.

critical_code_review_comments: The infinite loop bug was caused by including `t` (translation function) in useCallback dependencies. This is a common React anti-pattern. Translation functions should not be in dependency arrays as they change on every render.
seed_data_creation: Used existing members enrolled in 'كرة قدم 3 ايام في الاسبوع' activity for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Attendance module fully tested and working. Fixed critical infinite loop bug. All CRUD operations work: Load attendance by activity, Mark present/absent, Mark all present/absent, Save attendance. QR tab and Reports tab UI verified. Backend APIs all return 200 status codes.
